:::{#thm-aft-quantiles}
#### AFT models rescale every quantile

In an AFT model (@def-aft),
suppose the baseline survival function $\surv_0$ is continuous and strictly decreasing,
and let $t_q^0$ be the baseline time by which a fraction $q$ of subjects have had the event,
so that $\surv_0(t_q^0) = 1 - q$.
Then the corresponding time for covariate pattern $\vx$ is

$$
t_q(\vx) = \frac{t_q^0}{\hazfactor(\vx)}.
$$

:::
